messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Website is easier to push
parts:
I did two things:
1) on the server, the "public_html" folder is a github repository. All you have to do is log in and type "git pull"
2) there's a Jenkins job that will update the website on demand.

If the website needs to be updated, either 1 or 2 will work.



Daniel
